comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body:
The red colored version, as well as the Blue and green ones, are made with a special Florentine recipe with Anita in Lorenzos office in Florence. You need R13 Handicrafts, and 760 Handicrafts points (seems kinda strange it's made with handicrafts and not sewing...). Your also need 40 Velvet, 10 Exquisite Velvet, and 2 Exquisite Dye to make it.

And the black one can be found with a "Shipwreck route map" from the archives in Ambon or Ternate listed above.
